screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing elective aortic surgery, reporting blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blinded randomized prospective study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement, reporting blood loss. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials rather than a primary RCT. It does not meet the study design criterion.
Randomized study comparing aprotinin, DDAVP, and placebo/control in patients undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass surgery, reporting blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in CABG patients treated with aspirin, reporting postoperative bleeding. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomized controlled trial of DDAVP versus no DDAVP in patients undergoing orthognathic (bimaxillary osteotomy) surgery, reporting blood loss and hematocrit changes. Meets selection criteria.

Prospective, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial of DDAVP versus placebo in cardiac surgery patients identified by point-of-care testing, reporting blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Study compares DDAVP to saline following hydroxyethyl starch infusion but reports only laboratory coagulation parameters (von Willebrand factor ristocetin cofactor activity). It does not mention randomization or clinical blood loss/transfusion outcomes and appears to be a mechanistic study rather than an eligible RCT for this review.
Summary of NICE guidance on restrictive transfusion thresholds; does not evaluate DDAVP and is not an RCT.
Double-blind, randomized study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement, reporting blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets all selection criteria.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients with excessive bleeding after cardiopulmonary bypass, reporting blood loss and blood product requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Controlled trial comparing DDAVP to saline control in patients undergoing valvular heart surgery, reporting postoperative blood loss and fresh frozen plasma transfusion. Randomization is not explicitly stated in the abstract, but the two-group controlled surgical design and relevant clinical outcomes warrant conservative inclusion at the title/abstract stage.

Randomized controlled trial comparing intranasal DDAVP to blood transfusion (active comparator) in cirrhotic patients with acquired coagulopathy undergoing dental extraction (an invasive procedure). The population does not have inherited bleeding disorders and bleeding outcomes are reported. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind randomized trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total joint arthroplasty, reporting blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets all selection criteria.

Controlled study of DDAVP in aspirin-treated patients undergoing cholecystectomy, but the abstract contains no mention of randomization, allocation concealment, or blinding. The very small sample size (n=12) and lack of RCT terminology suggest it is not a randomized controlled trial.
Randomized clinical trial of DDAVP versus saline in patients undergoing functional endoscopic sinus surgery, reporting intraoperative blood loss and surgical field quality. Meets selection criteria.

Randomized, double-blind, controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients having Harrington rod spinal fusion surgery, reporting operative blood loss and erythrocyte transfusion needs. Meets selection criteria.

Double-blind, randomized trial of DDAVP versus saline placebo in cardiac surgical patients pretreated with aspirin, reporting homologous blood requirements and postoperative blood loss. Meets all selection criteria.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized study comparing aprotinin, desmopressin, and placebo in patients undergoing operations with cardiopulmonary bypass, reporting blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Randomized double-blind study of DDAVP versus saline placebo after CABG. Although the primary focus is hemodynamics, the study reports postoperative blood loss and represents an RCT of DDAVP versus placebo in cardiac surgery. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomized, prospective trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients on cardiopulmonary bypass during surgery, reporting blood loss and red cell transfusions. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind randomized study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing spinal fusion for neuromuscular scoliosis, reporting operative blood loss. Meets selection criteria.
Randomized, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in routine coronary artery bypass surgery, reporting blood loss and blood transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.
Systematic review and meta-analysis comparing restrictive versus liberal transfusion strategies; does not evaluate DDAVP. Not an RCT of DDAVP.
Methodological paper on tests for small-study effects in meta-analyses of controlled trials; not a primary study of DDAVP.

Prospective, blinded RCT comparing DDAVP (single and repeated doses) to placebo in adults undergoing uncomplicated CABG, measuring blood loss and blood product replacement, with no mention of inherited bleeding disorders.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial comparing DDAVP to placebo after primary CABG in adults, evaluating postoperative blood loss, haemoglobin loss, and red cell transfusion requirements.
Double-blind, randomized study comparing DDAVP to placebo in adults undergoing cardiac operations, assessing postoperative blood loss and replacement therapy.
This is a correspondence letter discussing sedation for intravenous line placement in children; it is not an RCT evaluating DDAVP for perioperative blood loss or transfusion reduction.
Randomized, blinded trial comparing DDAVP to saline placebo after cardiopulmonary bypass in children undergoing cardiac surgery, measuring 24-hour blood loss and blood replacement.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel-group trial comparing DDAVP to vehicle after uncomplicated CABG in adults, evaluating postoperative blood loss.
Retrospective cohort study examining outcomes in patients who declined transfusion for religious reasons; it does not evaluate DDAVP and is not an RCT.
Randomized trial evaluating DDAVP for thrombosis prevention after diagnostic catheterization; the outcome is thromboprophylaxis rather than perioperative blood loss or red cell transfusion.

Double-blind RCT comparing pre-procedure DDAVP to placebo in adults undergoing percutaneous kidney biopsy, evaluating bleeding complications and hematoma size; the protocol explicitly includes RCTs after invasive procedures.
This is a clinical guideline on the diagnosis and management of von Willebrand disease, not a primary RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo or an active comparator.
Double-blind, randomized, prospective trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing major scoliosis surgery, measuring intraoperative blood loss and coagulation parameters.

Double-blind RCT comparing two doses of DDAVP versus placebo intraoperatively in adults undergoing total hip arthroplasty, with total blood loss and red cell transfusion requirements as key endpoints.

The title indicates an original clinical study evaluating DDAVP to reduce blood transfusion requirements during cardiac surgery in adults with drug-induced platelet dysfunction (not inherited bleeding disorders); although the abstract is truncated, the topic clearly matches the review PICO, so it is included conservatively.
This is a narrative review summarizing DDAVP use across multiple conditions; it is not a primary randomized controlled trial.
This appears to be a brief summary or commentary of the kidney biopsy RCT rather than the primary trial report, lacking full methodological details needed for screening.
This is a review article about transfusion reactions; it does not report an RCT of DDAVP for perioperative blood loss.
Placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial comparing preoperative DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing burn débridement and grafting, measuring operative blood loss.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial comparing DDAVP to saline placebo in adults undergoing elective cardiac surgery, evaluating postoperative blood loss and need for blood product replacement.
This is a national survey of red blood cell utilization; it is not an RCT and does not evaluate DDAVP.
Large observational database study of reoperation for bleeding after CABG; it is not an RCT and does not evaluate DDAVP.
This is a clinical guideline on platelet transfusions, not a primary RCT of DDAVP.
Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in adults with active bleeding after cardiac surgery, evaluating red blood cell transfusion requirements.
This is a methodological paper about detecting bias in meta-analyses; it is not a clinical trial of DDAVP.
This is a basic science review of cellular mechanisms of DDAVP; it is not a clinical RCT in a surgical or invasive procedure setting.

Randomized, prospective, double-blind trial comparing a single dose of DDAVP to saline placebo in adults undergoing major flap reconstructive surgery, measuring intraoperative blood loss and transfusion requirements.

Randomized, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in 20 adults undergoing elective CABG. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, DDAVP vs placebo, perioperative cardiac surgery setting, and no inherited bleeding disorders.
Study evaluates DDAVP in Bernard-Soulier syndrome, which is an inherited bleeding disorder. The review specifically excludes people with inherited bleeding disorders.
This is a clinical guideline, not a randomized controlled trial. Additionally, it focuses on hereditary bleeding disorders, which are outside the review population.

Observational study in which desmopressin was administered to patients based on clinical indication of increased bleeding tendency. There is no mention of randomization; groups were defined by existing antiplatelet therapy and clinical need.
This is a guideline update document, not an individual randomized controlled trial.
This is a meta-analysis of multiple trials, not an individual randomized controlled trial.
This is a meta-analysis evaluating multiple drugs (desmopressin, epsilon-aminocaproic acid/tranexamic acid, and aprotinin), not an individual RCT of DDAVP.
This is a narrative review discussing alternatives to platelet transfusion, not a randomized controlled trial.

Prospective, single-blind comparative study of tranexamic acid versus desmopressin in 40 patients undergoing total knee replacement. Included conservatively because it compares DDAVP to an active comparator (tranexamic acid) in a perioperative setting and may be an RCT, though randomization is not explicitly stated in the abstract.

Single-arm prospective study in which all 23 enrolled patients received desmopressin before invasive procedures. There is no control group, so it is not an RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo or an active comparator.

Although randomized, this study evaluates DDAVP in uremic patients about to commence hemodialysis without a perioperative surgical context. Outcomes are limited to laboratory parameters (closure time, factor levels), not perioperative blood loss or transfusion requirements.

Cohort study comparing consecutive patients before and after introduction of PFA-100 screening. Desmopressin was administered based on abnormal screening results, not randomized allocation. Not an RCT.

Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus saline placebo in 60 children undergoing cardiac operations. Meets all selection criteria including pediatric population and perioperative setting.

Randomized, placebo-controlled study comparing tranexamic acid, desmopressin, and saline in 30 adults undergoing total knee replacement. Meets all criteria: RCT design, DDAVP vs placebo and vs active comparator, perioperative setting.
Double-blinded, placebo-controlled study of DDAVP versus saline placebo in 27 adults undergoing elective cardiac surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Pharmacokinetic study evaluating different routes of DDAVP administration in non-surgical participants. Not a perioperative RCT comparing DDAVP to placebo or active comparator.
Randomized, controlled, double-blind study of DDAVP versus normal saline in 59 adults undergoing elective partial hepatectomy. Meets all selection criteria.
Duplicate of study_index 62. Cohort study comparing consecutive patients before and after introduction of PFA-100 screening, not an RCT.

Double-blinded RCT randomly allocating 163 adults undergoing cardiac surgery to placebo, tranexamic acid, desmopressin, or both drugs. Meets all selection criteria with DDAVP compared to placebo and to an active comparator.
Double-blind, prospective, randomized trial of DDAVP versus placebo in 70 adults undergoing various cardiac operations requiring cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomized trial of DDAVP versus placebo in 48 adults undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomized, double-blinded study of DDAVP versus placebo in 20 adults undergoing primary elective CABG. Meets all selection criteria.

Prospective randomized study in which both groups received desmopressin; group 1 received DDAVP alone and group 2 received DDAVP plus tranexamic acid. The study does not compare DDAVP to a non-DDAVP control (placebo or active comparator alone), so it does not meet the selection criteria.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of tranexamic acid trials, not an individual RCT of desmopressin.
Consensus paper and literature review developed by a writing group, not a randomized controlled trial.
Narrative review article summarizing desmopressin indications, not a randomized controlled trial and does not report original comparative perioperative transfusion data.

Prospective, placebo-controlled, double-blinded RCT comparing desmopressin to placebo in adults undergoing CABG with cardiopulmonary bypass. Evaluates perioperative bleeding and transfusion in patients without inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all selection criteria.

Controlled surgical study comparing desmopressin to a concurrent control group during lumbar fusion. Evaluates perioperative blood loss and autologous transfusion requirements. While randomization is not explicitly stated in the abstract, conservative screening favors inclusion for this controlled surgical cohort study.
Methodological guideline document (MECIR) about Cochrane review standards. No evaluation of desmopressin or primary clinical trial data.
Systematic review on transjugular liver biopsy quality and complications. Does not evaluate desmopressin intervention.

Case series/report of adverse events (hyponatraemia, seizures) in children under 2 years with inherited bleeding disorders treated with DDAVP. Not an RCT, wrong population, and adverse-event focus rather than transfusion reduction.

Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of desmopressin vs placebo in adults undergoing valvular heart surgery. Assesses perioperative blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.
Meta-analysis of multiple pharmacological strategies in cardiac surgery. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.

Double-blind, randomized placebo-controlled trial comparing desmopressin to saline in adults undergoing aortic valve replacement. Evaluates postoperative blood loss. Population has acquired platelet dysfunction (aortic stenosis), not inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT evaluating desmopressin vs placebo in aorto-iliac graft surgery. Measures blood loss, transfusion requirements, and safety in adults without inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing spinal fusion for idiopathic scoliosis. Evaluates intraoperative and postoperative blood loss. Population does not have inherited bleeding disorders. Meets selection criteria.

Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing complex congenital heart operations with cardiopulmonary bypass. Evaluates blood loss and transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.
Review article focused on von Willebrand's disease, an inherited bleeding disorder. Not a perioperative RCT in a population without inherited bleeding disorders.
Clinical practice guideline on trauma bleeding management. Not a randomized controlled trial of desmopressin.

Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of desmopressin in coronary artery bypass grafting surgery. Evaluates mediastinal chest tube drainage and homologous blood product use. Meets selection criteria.

Phase II dose-escalation trial without a placebo or active comparator group; evaluates safety and dose levels in breast cancer surgery. No randomization or control comparison described. Does not meet RCT criteria.

Prospective RCT with patients randomized equally to desmopressin or control groups undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting. Evaluates postoperative blood loss and transfusion needs. Meets selection criteria.
Meta-analysis of randomized trials on desmopressin in cardiac surgery. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.

Double-blind, randomized, prospective trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in patients undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass. Evaluates blood loss and red cell transfusion requirements. Meets selection criteria.

Prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial of desmopressin vs placebo in CABG patients receiving preoperative aspirin. Evaluates postoperative blood loss and transfusion outcomes. Meets selection criteria.
Non-randomized controlled study using sequential allocation (100 untreated followed by 100 treated patients) in cosmetic facioplasty. Not a randomized controlled trial.

Randomized, double-blind prospective study comparing desmopressin to placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement. Evaluates coagulation, fibrinolysis, and bleeding time perioperatively. Meets selection criteria.
Prospective randomized trial comparing DDAVP to placebo in uncomplicated coronary artery bypass surgery. Evaluates perioperative bleeding and red cell transfusions. Meets selection criteria.

Randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP in children with cerebral palsy undergoing spinal fusion for neuromuscular scoliosis. Evaluates blood loss and packed erythrocyte transfusion. Meets selection criteria.
Meta-analysis of pharmacological strategies in cardiac surgery. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
